fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully chain-link fenced along E 4th Ave (confirmed in multiple 2025 Street View panos); truck access is via gated driveway openings through the fence into the trailer yard. Controlled entry = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth structure found at any truck entrance in satellite or Street View. A small square structure sits mid-parking-lot near the office but it is an employee shelter, not a gate booth. Hence guardShack=false, remoteGs=true (fence/gate without guard implies kiosk/app/call-box check-in).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: a dairy processing plant (roof process tanks + row of milk silos confirmed in Street View) plus a large attached/adjacent distribution warehouse and a north rail-served covered loading dock structure.
fieldNotes.railServed: Long covered rail-dock structure with rail spur runs E-W along the north side of the property.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dense trailer drop yards on the south frontage, west of the plant, and around the north DC; many AMERICOLD/Kroger-brand reefer trailers parked nose-out. Easily 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South face of main plant shows dock-door numbering into the 20s (e.g. '25' markers in tight imagery); plus north DC and west-face docks. Estimated ~80 total across the campus.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on separate building faces / separate buildings (plant docks vs north DC docks).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate aprons and ample yard width at the south entrance leave room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single-lane gated driveways observed; lane counts approximate.
